name: Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad 2030 (Decreto 313-22)
owner: Centro Nacional de Ciberseguridad de la República Dominicana
description: Estrategia Nacional de Ciberseguridad 2030 (Decreto No. 313-22 of June 14, 2022). National cybersecurity strategy of the Dominican Republic enacted by Presidential Decree, defining strategic pillars for legal/institutional strengthening, critical infrastructure protection, cybersecurity education, and national/international alliances.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Centro Nacional de Ciberseguridad de la República Dominicana (cncs.gob.do) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Centro Nacional de Ciberseguridad de la República Dominicana (cncs.gob.do).
